research_findings: The application lacked a robust rate-limiting implementation for the waitlist signup feature, leading to potential abuse and spam.
Upstash Redis and Ratelimit libraries were required to construct an effective distributed rate limiter.
features_improved: Waitlist signup endpoint (`src/app/actions/waitlist.ts`) now implements rate limiting (5 requests per 60 seconds) to protect against heavy traffic and spam.
new_features_added: Integrated `@upstash/ratelimit` and `@upstash/redis` to construct a Token Bucket rate-limiting abstraction layer (`src/lib/ratelimit.ts`).
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement rate-limiting checks universally across other susceptible authentication and AI-evaluation endpoints.
Introduce a robust Redis mock testing environment for automated verifications.
